name: Homebridge
author: Ian Swope
description: Your home in the Omarchy bar: arm and disarm the security system Homebridge bridges, toggle and dim the lights, and read the sensors — contact, motion, smoke, leak — without opening an app.

barWidget.description: Homebridge in the bar. Sets the security system's mode (asking first), toggles any light, switch or outlet, dims a dimmable light, and reads contact, motion, smoke, CO, leak, temperature and humidity sensors. Talks to Homebridge over its local API with a dedicated, non-admin user.

schema.label: Show the number of lights and switches that are on
schema.description: Shown in the bar beside the icon. A home with nothing on shows nothing.

schema.label: Show the security system's mode in the bar
schema.description: Shows Home, Away or Night beside the icon while the system is armed, and nothing while it is off. An alarm going off always shows, whatever this is set to.

schema.label: Temperature
schema.description: HomeKit always reports Celsius. This is only how it is read out.
